title: Tail bound for a reasonable variable
statement: Let $\Omega$ be finite, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ be reasonable with constant $B$. Suppose $X$ is nonzero at some point having positive probability. For every $t>0$, the probability under $p$ that $|X|\ge t\sqrt{\mathbb{E}_p[X^2]}$ is at most $B/t^4$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$X$ is nonzero at some point with positive probability
